Just fyi you tried to post ^_^ but it came out messed up. This is because when reddit sees the ^ character it thinks you want to write in super script like this . The way to prevent this is to use the escape character \ which tells reddit to ignore any special formatting that the next character would create. So to get ^_^ what you need to do is write \^_\^ in the editor. Cheers.
